title: THE EMPTY PLATFORM
message: It is coming. Just not yet.
meaning:
The Empty Platform is delay without cancellation. Something is on its way, but it cannot be seen yet, and waiting is the only available action.

The card separates a postponement from a refusal.
imageAlt: An empty old railway platform at night or at dawn. Far off, two pale lights are barely visible, but no train can be made out yet.
